profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Problem Solver | Full-Stack Development | Driving Innovation & Performance | Building Scalable & Secure Web Applications | Collaborative Team Player
profile.summary:
With a strong foundation in full-stack software engineering, I specialize in crafting scalable, secure, and high-performance applications that help organizations streamline processes and safeguard critical data. My expertise spans across front-end and back-end development, ensuring seamless integrations and a smooth user experience while adhering to industry best practices.

I thrive in collaborative environments, leveraging agile methodologies, code reviews, and pair programming to drive innovation and efficiency. My passion lies in problem-solving and optimizing system performance, ensuring that every solution I develop is future-proof, maintainable, and aligned with business goals. Whether refining existing systems or implementing new features, I am committed to creating software that not only meets technical standards but also empowers end-users to work smarter and more efficiently.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Drove ongoing enhancements in a full-stack software development environment, refining multiple bioinformatics LIMS and delivering support to laboratory staff and project managers. Supported and maintained quality coding standards while adhering to all HIPAA and CLIA compliance; acquired HIPAA certification yearly. Upgraded LIMS to support newer technology, such as improved data tracking and implementing SSL connections for RESTful APIs used. Integrated Google Cloud Pub/Sub for managing real-time event driven messaging between applications in a controlled, secure manner. Helped design and implement features within LIMS to better support the user base.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined Broad Institute as a Software Engineer and promoted to Senior Software Engineer based on demonstrated leadership skills, software expertise and contributions to outstanding initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Software & Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software features for environment monitoring devices as well as an application that was provided to customers to monitor their devices.
Provided phone, email, and live-chat support, often at the same time.

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description: Recruited as a Product Engineer and advanced to Senior Software & Firmware Engineer within 13 months based on ability to multitask, excelling in software development and providing technical support to non-technical users.

positions.title: Intern Link Manager and PHP Programmer
